title: Rules.
bodyText: Any government agency may adopt, amend, or repeal rules pursuant to chapter 91 as the agency deems necessary to implement this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§92H-7]  Rules.  Any government agency may adopt, amend, or repeal rules pursuant to chapter 91 as the agency deems necessary to implement this chapter. [L 2024, c 187, pt of §2]
